shortDescription: route map configuration handling for SONiC

options.name: config
options.description: Specifies a list of route map configuration dictionaries

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the type of configuration update to be performed on the device. For C(merged), merge specified attributes with existing configured attributes. For C(deleted), delete the specified attributes from existing configuration. For C(replaced), replace each modified list or dictionary with the specified items. For C(overridden), replace all current configuration for this resource module with the specified configuration.
